output.reason: Evidence (UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, para 261(2)(ii)) states that a prepayment charge is not permitted (50 INR). It further specifies applicability to the case: bank is a Tier 3 UCB, loan rate type is floating, purpose is business, borrower is MSE, and sanctioned amount is ₹4,000,000 ≤ ₹5,000,000 (i.e., up to ₹50 lakh), with the relevant sanctioned date condition satisfied. This matches the claim that such a Tier 3 floating-rate business loan to an MSE with sanctioned amount up to ₹50 lakh is covered by the Directions that prohibit pre-payment charges.
